pages.text: Everyone riding can press $(k:key.reikocars.radio) to open the radio: power, three stations and a disc slot.$(br)$(li)$(l)88.1 Neon FM$(): synthwave$(li)$(l)94.5 Chill FM$(): lo-fi beats$(li)$(l)101.3 Dusty Roads$(): country guitar$(br2)The stations play round the clock, so every car on one hears the same moment of the same song.
DISC plays the music disc in the slot, on repeat. People outside hear it too.
